panels.visual: Diogenes lying in a huge clay jar (pithos) in the Agora, a cloak, a stick and a bag beside him, a scruffy dog at his feet
panels.caption: Diogenes lived in a big clay jar. He owned a cloak, a stick and a bag.

panels.visual: A boy scooping water in his cupped hands from a fountain and drinking, Diogenes watching
panels.caption: One day he saw a boy scoop up water in his hands and drink.

speech.speaker: Diogenes
speech.text: Even my cup is too much.

panels.visual: Alexander the Great (young, golden armour and a purple cape) standing over Diogenes' jar with soldiers behind him, the sun behind him
panels.caption: Alexander the Great offered him anything he wanted.

speech.speaker: Diogenes
speech.text: Stand a little out of my sunlight.

panels.visual: Diogenes' dog barking at a crowd while Diogenes grins and begs in the street, a comic scene
panels.caption: People called him the dog. His followers were Cynics, from the Greek for dog-like.

panels.visual: Diogenes walking through the busy Agora in broad daylight holding a lit lamp, shopkeepers staring
panels.caption: Diogenes walked through the Agora in broad daylight carrying a lit lamp.

panels.visual: Diogenes peering with his lamp into the face of a puzzled Athenian merchant, big eyes
panels.caption: He held the lamp up to every face.

panels.visual: Plato at the board of his school drawing a two-legged stick figure 'a featherless biped', students nodding
panels.caption: Plato described a human being as a featherless biped.

panels.visual: Diogenes holding up a plucked chicken in front of Plato's school, students laughing, Plato shocked
panels.caption: Diogenes held up a plucked chicken outside Plato's school.
